title: Fitness/outdoor training
description: You will need your own mat for the training. If you want, you can also bring a drinking bottle with you - we hope you have a lot of fun during the training.

title: Wednesday meeting
description: The Flat-5 jazz band and songwriter Mommel combine groovy jazz with poetic lyrics to create a special concert experience. Sonorous arrangements and personal songs create an atmospheric atmosphere.

title: Exchange on the sofa
description:
We would like to stay in conversation with you. With our new format “Exchange on the Sofa” we are creating an additional offer for open encounters in a cozy atmosphere.
Here you can raise your concerns early, address your own topics or simply listen. Without a program, without registration – just come along and talk to community leader Johannes Hasler on the “sofa in the Grossabünt”. The Grossabünt offers the perfect environment for this – before the respective Wednesday meetings.

title: Summer party / pig in a poke
description:
Friday, August 14, 2026, from 4:00 p.m. to 9:30 p.m

Summer party of the Society Commission meets “Cat in a Sack” – Moseg and more...

We're ending the summer holidays with a great combination event. The “Summer Festival of the Society Commission” meets “Cat in a Sack” – Moseg and more...
The program:
4:00 p.m.:                Start of the summer festival. We are spoiled with culinary delights by them
Restaurants Zentrum and Falknis as well as the wagon building association. Also included are
the Granville Café with various coffee delicacies and Martin Telser
with its fine ice creams. DJ Jonas provides the right music.
6:00 p.m. - 7:30 p.m.:    “Cat in a poke” - Moses and more... As usual, it will only be a few days before
announced who will surprise us musically. So much can be revealed, it
is the “spiciest” Balzner band.
7.30 p.m. - 9.30 p.m.:    Summer party: cozy end with delicacies from the kitchen and refrigerator and
lots of music.

The event only takes place in good weather.
